newsitem.title: USA: Enterprise forms deregulated energy firm.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise forms deregulated energy firm.

text.p: Public Service Enterprise Group said Thursday it had formed a company, Energis Resources, to consolidate and expand the company's share of the rapidly deregulating energy market.
Energis Resources will market new and existing energy products and services to commercial and industrial business customers throughout the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic States.
It has consolidated functions previously performed by several Enterprise companies, including U.S. Energy Partners and Enterprise Strategic Energy Solutions, Enterprise said.
The new company currently provides natural gas to more than 3,600 business clients, the company said.

It said Energis Resources offers services through three product platforms: Energy Supply, including natural gas now and electricity in the future; Business Solutions, including a variety of energy management, operation and maintenance services; and Financing Solutions, offering financing plans to help customers upgrade equipment and reduce energy costs.

One of the primary services offered by the company is Total Energy Management -- a custom-tailored, bundled offering of energy supply and proven energy-related technologies, together with business and financial solutions.
Currently operating from Maine to Maryland, Energis Resources will be headquartered in Edison, N.J., with 115 employees. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
